team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R1: after using an Elemental Skill or Burst (ATK +24%), if the equipping character creates a Shield while that effect is active, all nearby party members gain Electrifying Edict: +40% Lunar-Charged DMG for 20s.

en.flavor: A spinning mechanical blade produced by the Clink-Clank Krumkake Craftshop that seems to hide secrets from a bygone era...

refinements.1: After an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst is used, ATK is increased by <r>24%</r> for 20s. If the equipping character creates a Shield while this effect is active, they will gain the Electrifying Edict effect for 20s: All nearby party members deal <r>40%</r> more Lunar-Charged DMG.

refinements.3: After an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst is used, ATK is increased by <r>36%</r> for 20s. If the equipping character creates a Shield while this effect is active, they will gain the Electrifying Edict effect for 20s: All nearby party members deal <r>60%</r> more Lunar-Charged DMG.
refinements.4: After an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst is used, ATK is increased by <r>42%</r> for 20s. If the equipping character creates a Shield while this effect is active, they will gain the Electrifying Edict effect for 20s: All nearby party members deal <r>70%</r> more Lunar-Charged DMG.
refinements.5: After an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst is used, ATK is increased by <r>48%</r> for 20s. If the equipping character creates a Shield while this effect is active, they will gain the Electrifying Edict effect for 20s: All nearby party members deal <r>80%</r> more Lunar-Charged DMG.
